Product Design
Unreleased Project

Overview

iPure Herbs is a herbal wellness e-commerce platform designed primarily for B2B buyers — retailers and distributors purchasing natural health and wellness products in bulk. With a small, focused product range, the platform needed to simplify pricing transparency, product trust, and repeat ordering for buyers making purchasing decisions at scale, rather than individual, one-off consumers.

Services

Product Design Visual Design Design System Interaction Design

Challenge

  • Designing an efficient experience around a small catalog - with a limited number of SKUs, the challenge wasn't organizing scale, it was making sure a lean product range still felt easy to browse, compare, and reorder without the experience feeling sparse or under-built.
  • Making bulk pricing transparent without over-exposing it - buyers wanted to see cost at scale before committing, but pricing visibility had business sensitivity attached to it.
  • Surfacing trust without cluttering the PDP - certifications, sourcing, and lab testing needed to feel authoritative, not like an afterthought badge, especially important when the catalog itself is small and each product needs to work harder to earn confidence.
  • Working from desk research only - no direct access to real B2B buyers meant every assumption had to be built from competitive analysis, B2B e-commerce UX benchmarks, and client input, then flagged as an assumption rather than a validated fact.

Solution

Designed an end-to-end e-commerce experience - home, category/listing, product detail, and cart/checkout - structured around three core decisions:

  • Tiered pricing made visible on the PDP - a buyer can evaluate cost-at-scale without needing to log in or contact sales first, reducing friction in the comparison stage.
  • A faster path back to previously ordered products - addressing the core B2B behavior of repeat, high-volume ordering rather than one-off discovery — especially valuable with a small catalog, where buyers reorder the same handful of items regularly.
  • A dedicated, prominent space for sourcing, certification, and lab-testing information on the PDP - B2B buyers are reselling on their own reputation and need to verify credibility before committing to bulk orders on a limited product range.

The visual system stayed warm and approachable — closer to a specialty retailer than a sterile B2B portal — so smaller or first-time retailers wouldn't feel like they'd landed in enterprise software.

Role

Sole designer responsible for the end-to-end e-commerce experience — from product structure and page architecture to UI, visual system, and interaction design across home, listing, and detail pages.

Key Learnings & Outcome

This project was completed through final design handoff but has not been released, so there's no live usage data to report — the outcomes here are design outcomes rather than business metrics.

  • Delivered a complete design system and end-to-end UI covering the full purchase journey from discovery to checkout, built for a small but focused catalog.
  • Learned that a small catalog changes the design problem — it's less about navigation and filtering at scale, and more about making each product page earn trust and justify a bulk order on its own.
  • Because research was desk-based rather than direct user interviews, the biggest gap going forward would be usability testing with real wholesale buyers — particularly to validate the pricing-visibility decision, which was made on reasoned assumption rather than tested behavior.
  • If revisited, the next step would be a lightweight validation round (even 5 target buyers) before further investment, to de-risk the assumptions this version was built on.

Casing reinforces
hierarchy and consistency

All headlines use capitalized first letters (Title Case) to ensure clarity and presence. Buttons are written in all caps to emphasize action. For small UI elements such as tabs or sublabels, uppercase text improves legibility and visual structure at small sizes

Playfair display is a modern, versatile sans-serif typeface designed for high legibility across digital interfaces. With open letterforms, optimized spacing, and strong clarity at any size, Inter performs reliably in both functional and expressive contexts

We chose Inter as our primary typeface for its neutrality, clarity, and performance across screen sizes. Its technical precision and contemporary tone reflect SCRYPT's commitment to efficiency, reliability, and institutional-grade design
